integrity: The proof is unrestricted and exhausts prime powers, two-prime support, and support of size at least three. Publicly recorded prime-power and squarefree formulas are rederived; the finite verifier is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only fibers \(0\) through \(8\). It does not settle the conjectured finiteness of every fiber \(z(n)=k\) for \(k\ge3\).
title: Sharp repeated-support barrier and fibers through \(8\) for \(\sigma(n)+\varphi(n)-2n\)
